<?php
trait T {
    public static function m($v = 7) {
        static $n = 0;
        echo "T:", self::class, ":", static::class, ":", $v, ":", ++$n, ";";
    }
    public const Y = self::q(...);
    public static $x = self::Y;
}
trait U { use T; }
set_error_handler(static function () { return true; });
class C {
    use U { m as q; }
    public static $x = self::Y;
    public static function m() { echo "OWN;"; }
}
$f = C::Y;
$f();
$g = clone $f;
$g();
C::m();

<?php
trait T {
    protected static function m($v = 5) {
        static $n = 0;
        echo "T:", self::class, ":", static::class, ":", $v, ":", ++$n, ";";
    }
    public const Y = self::m(...);
    public static $x = self::Y;
}
trait U { use T; }
set_error_handler(static function () { return true; });
class C {
    use U { m as public; }
    public static $x = self::Y;
}
$f = C::Y;
$f();
C::m();

<?php
trait T {
    public static function m($v = 7) {
        static $n = 0;
        echo "T:", self::class, ":", static::class, ":", $v, ":", ++$n, ";";
    }
    public const Y = self::q(...);
    public static $x = self::Y;
}
trait U { use T; }
trait V {
    public static function m($v = 9) {
        static $n = 0;
        echo "V:", self::class, ":", static::class, ":", $v, ":", ++$n, ";";
    }
}
set_error_handler(static function () { return true; });
class C {
    use U, V { U::m insteadof V; V::m as q; }
    public static $x = self::Y;
}
$f = C::Y;
$f();
C::m();
